_comment: Copy to config/escalation.json, fill in email and jiraAccountId, then run `npm run resolve:ids` to fill entraObjectId from Microsoft Entra. Teams rejects an email or user principal name when addressing someone, so the object id is what the bot actually needs; email is only recorded so the id can be looked up. jiraAccountId is the accountId Jira reports for that person, and is how a breached request finds its assignee here. Only people who can be assignees need one.
